== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Lieutenant Cabbel: the entry “Lieutenant Cabbel” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 82. Image for [[Lieutenant Cabbel (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 82 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>663fdb915ff5089d56f7a72dbaf3a0b7aaf57405</code>, SHA-256 <code>cdf9da2b0e3357efe5e704cf90de33cffa541030de93c959f91c3f6a46d75632</code>.
